text:
Sam (CEO): quick weekly pulse — three asks and a short metrics note. please react if blocking.
Sam (CEO): 1) Privacy: hosted API default retention -> 90 days. Priya/Hana to finalize customer copy by Fri COB.
Sam (CEO): 2) Private GA: internal rollout target next Wed; external invites for select pilots the following week. product+eng confirm onboarding checklist green by Mon EOD.
Sam (CEO): 3) Reliability: staging canary hit a memory leak in batching yesterday; rollback done, no prod impact. SRE+eng to own postmortem.
Sam (CEO): Metrics: p50 latency improved ~10% WoW; p95 up ~7% due to long tail; cost/token down ~2%. focus on p95 variance.
Priya - VP Product: ack. I'll draft the customer note+FAQ and loop Hana.
Priya - VP Product: I'll also spin up a GA readiness board and ping owners Mon 09:15 PT.
Diego - Eng Lead: PRs: #5010 telemetry-flag, #5011 batching-hotfix. Hotfix has unit tests. staging redeploy planned tomorrow AM.
Morgan (SRE): incident brief: staging OOM at 01:47 UTC from large prefix batches. Rolled back to v1.23.9 at 02:05 UTC. Postmortem Thu 15:00 UTC in #incidents. Runbook link posted.
Alex - Head of Sales: several pilots asked about early access. Priya/Hana can we get a 1-paragraph outreach by Mon noon?
Hana (Legal): suggested phrasing: "Default retention 90 days; extended retention via contract." Will post redlines Thu AM and include DPA link.
deploy-bot: rollback executed: v1.24.0 -> v1.23.9 by Morgan (SRE) at 02:05 UTC. Log: "ROLLBACK: MEM_PRESSURE_DETECTED"
Diego - Eng Lead: propose extending canary window 30m->2h for batch-sensitive releases and add kv-cache healthchecks. Will update rollout template.
Sam (CEO): agree. Diego & Morgan coordinate the extended canary and update the checklist.
Sam (CEO): Org asks: A) surface any GA blockers by Mon 09:00 PT. B) if you can't attend postmortem, add notes to the doc beforehand.
Alex - Head of Sales: will draft outreach paragraph and share Mon noon.
Priya - VP Product: will ping owners Mon 09:15 PT.
Morgan (SRE): postmortem doc + dial-in in #incidents; requesting Diego, infra, and one on-call dev.
Sam (CEO): thanks team — small, focused week. keep updates here or DM urgent items. :thumbsup:
__comments: Slack thread stored as a single continuous string; messages chronological; no title per agents.md.
